records.text: Hollywood was founded by gangs, including Jewish mafiosos and bootleggers.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Actually, factually speaking, Hollywood was started by gangs. Yes, there were Jewish mafiosos, bootleggers.

verification.notes: Histories of early Hollywood identify predominantly Jewish immigrant entrepreneurs from retail and theater businesses as major studio founders, not gangs or bootleggers. Organized crime later intersected with Hollywood, but that does not support the founding claim.

sources.title: Jews in Hollywood, 1930–1950
sources.relevance: Historical overview identifies the early moguls as immigrant entrepreneurs whose prior work was largely retail and theater, not gang activity.

sources.title: Hollywood Politics — Oxford Research Encyclopedia of American History
sources.relevance: Scholarly account describes Jewish film-industry founders seeking legitimacy within a Christian political establishment, not Hollywood being founded by gangs.

records.text: Charlie Kirk was killed when he tried to leave an entertainment gang.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He's dead now. When he wanted out, he was killed.

verification.notes: This is Owens's entertainment-gang motive allegation. The public charging theory identifies a different alleged motive, but an unresolved charging record does not prove Owens's alternative motive false; no independent evidence supports or conclusively refutes her claim.
